title: simulation result.json contract
description: Complete contract for asic/<module>/Verification/simulation/result.json. On status=fail, stage_specific.{failure_phase, fail_reason} are required (if/then below); fail_reason is the one-line failure narrative, and failure_phase identifies which sub-step (prerequisite/compile/smoke/regress/coverage/conformance) tripped. Both are absent on pass. Only routing-relevant fields are enumerated below; informational fields (total_cases, coverage_summary, etc.) live free under additionalProperties.

failing_cases.description: One entry per case that failed this run, written by the verify child and read by simulation-triage. The shape is declared here because the triage contract names these fields: without test_id it cannot reach run_logs/<test_id>.log, and error_message is the log anchor its Step-1 reasoning starts from.

log_snippet.description: Optional: the tail around the first UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL. Triage falls back to the full per-case log when it is absent or truncated.

conformance_findings.description: The gating subset of conformance-review.json's findings[], copied verbatim by finalize. Same shape as its source (references/conformance-review.schema.json): re-declaring it here keeps the envelope from un-validating a structure that was validated one file earlier. `category` is the reasoning key simulation-triage attributes on when there is no log to anchor.
